$comment: Mirrors app.api.intel_schemas.NoteRecordRequest. Catch-all prose intel that doesn't fit a structured row; still FTS-indexed and engagement-scoped.
title: Intel Note Record — free-form prose intel that doesn't fit a structured row (tech, email, domain, CVE, etc.). FTS-indexed and engagement-scoped. Optionally promoted to a tracked lead via lead_status.

title.description: Short, unique title per engagement — serves as the natural dedup key; a re-record with the same title overwrites the prior row.

body_markdown.description: Prose body in GitHub-flavored markdown. Include commands, output excerpts, and reasoning — this is FTS-indexed and used in report/resume context.

source_agent.description: Specialist role that authored this note (e.g., 'osint-analyst', 'vulnerability-analyst').

source_name.description: External source or tool the note summarizes (e.g., 'shodan', 'nuclei-template-xyz', 'github-advisory').

lead_status.description: Omit/null for a plain reference note. Set to promote this note to a tracked lead (actionable hypothesis): 'open'/'in_progress'=on the worklist; 'resolved'/'ruled_out'=closed. Re-recording with the same title overwrites the prior disposition.

agent_name.description: Specialist agent role that recorded this row.

artifact_ref.description: vigil artifact ID or path that contains the raw evidence.

captured_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when this row was written.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim excerpt that supports this note.
